body:
# Vivere con il Cane - v0.1.0 Release

**Release Date:** 2026-05-07
**Version:** 0.1.0 (Initial Production Release)
**Status:** Stable - Production Ready
**Test Results:** 138/144 passed (95.8%)

## Features

- AI Behavior Analysis (Groq API)
- Free Canine Tools (calculator, quiz, heart recorder)
- Knowledge Base (50+ problems, breed insights)
- Community Forum with reputation & badges
- Dog Profile & Health Tracking
- Newsletter Automation
- AI-Generated Blog
- Progressive Web App (PWA)

See README.md, CHANGELOG.md, TEST_REPORT.md for full details.

🚀 Production release
